name: Agent Health Overview
description: Cloud Agent turns and Code Reviewer reviews. Production only.

charts.name: Completed turns, % of completed + failed (last hour)

query.apl:
['cloudflare-logpush']
| where ['ScriptName'] == 'cloud-agent-next' and ['EventType'] == 'scheduled'
| mv-expand ['Logs']
| extend j = parse_json(tostring(['Logs']['Message'][0]))
| where tostring(j['metric']) == 'agent_execution'
| project _time, obs = todatetime(j['observedAt']), ws = todatetime(j['windowStart']), generation = tostring(j['generation']), role = tostring(j['role']), origin = tostring(j['productOrigin']), completed = tolong(j['completed']), platformFailed = tolong(j['platformFailed']), providerFailed = tolong(j['providerFailed']), userFailed = tolong(j['userFailed']), unknownFailed = tolong(j['unknownFailed']), interrupted = tolong(j['interrupted'])
| summarize arg_max(obs, _time, completed, platformFailed, providerFailed, userFailed, unknownFailed, interrupted) by ws, generation, role, origin
| extend settled = completed + platformFailed + providerFailed + userFailed + unknownFailed
| where ws >= ago(65m)
| summarize goodSum = sum(completed), settledSum = sum(settled)
| project ['of completed + failed turns'] = iff(settledSum > 0, round(100.0 * goodSum / settledSum, 1), todouble(dynamic(null)))

charts.name: Completed reviews, % of ended reviews (last hour)

query.apl:
['vercel']
| where ['request.path'] == '/api/cron/code-review-outcome-aggregate' and ['vercel.environment'] == 'production'
| where ['message'] has '"metric":"review_outcome"'
| extend j = parse_json(['message'])
| where tostring(j['metric']) == 'review_outcome'
| project _time, obs = todatetime(j['observedAt']), ws = todatetime(j['windowStart']), completed = tolong(j['completed']), failed = tolong(j['failed']), cancelled = tolong(j['cancelled']), interrupted = tolong(j['interrupted']), durationCount = tolong(j['durationCount']), durationMs = todouble(j['durationMs'])
| summarize arg_max(obs, _time, completed, failed, cancelled, interrupted, durationCount, durationMs) by ws
| extend terminal = completed + failed + cancelled + interrupted
| where ws >= ago(65m)
| summarize completedSum = sum(completed), terminalSum = sum(terminal)
| project ['of ended reviews'] = iff(terminalSum > 0, round(100.0 * completedSum / terminalSum, 1), todouble(dynamic(null)))

charts.name: Avg completed review run time, excludes queue wait (last hour)

query.apl:
['vercel']
| where ['request.path'] == '/api/cron/code-review-outcome-aggregate' and ['vercel.environment'] == 'production'
| where ['message'] has '"metric":"review_outcome"'
| extend j = parse_json(['message'])
| where tostring(j['metric']) == 'review_outcome'
| project _time, obs = todatetime(j['observedAt']), ws = todatetime(j['windowStart']), completed = tolong(j['completed']), failed = tolong(j['failed']), cancelled = tolong(j['cancelled']), interrupted = tolong(j['interrupted']), durationCount = tolong(j['durationCount']), durationMs = todouble(j['durationMs'])
| summarize arg_max(obs, _time, completed, failed, cancelled, interrupted, durationCount, durationMs) by ws
| extend terminal = completed + failed + cancelled + interrupted
| where ws >= ago(65m)
| summarize totalMs = sum(durationMs), sampleCount = sum(durationCount)
| project ['minutes'] = iff(sampleCount > 0, round(totalMs / sampleCount / 60000.0, 1), todouble(dynamic(null)))

['vercel']
| where ['request.path'] == '/api/cron/code-review-outcome-aggregate' and ['vercel.environment'] == 'production'
| where ['message'] has '"metric":"review_open"'
| extend j = parse_json(['message'])
| where tostring(j['metric']) == 'review_open'
| project _time, obs = todatetime(j['observedAt']), pending = tolong(j['pending']), over5 = tolong(j['pendingOverFiveMinutes']), oldestMs = todouble(j['oldestPendingAgeMs']), stale = tolong(j['staleQueued']), running90 = tolong(j['runningOverNinetyMinutes']), missing = tolong(j['missingCompletedAt'])
| top 1 by obs desc
| where obs > ago(30m)
| project ['reviews'] = pending

charts.name: Completed, % (Cloud Agent turns, Code Reviewer reviews)

query.apl:
union
  (
    ['cloudflare-logpush']
    | where ['ScriptName'] == 'cloud-agent-next' and ['EventType'] == 'scheduled'
    | mv-expand ['Logs']
    | extend j = parse_json(tostring(['Logs']['Message'][0]))
    | where tostring(j['metric']) == 'agent_execution'
    | project _time, obs = todatetime(j['observedAt']), ws = todatetime(j['windowStart']), generation = tostring(j['generation']), role = tostring(j['role']), origin = tostring(j['productOrigin']), completed = tolong(j['completed']), platformFailed = tolong(j['platformFailed']), providerFailed = tolong(j['providerFailed']), userFailed = tolong(j['userFailed']), unknownFailed = tolong(j['unknownFailed']), interrupted = tolong(j['interrupted'])
    | summarize arg_max(obs, _time, completed, platformFailed, providerFailed, userFailed, unknownFailed, interrupted) by ws, generation, role, origin
    | extend settled = completed + platformFailed + providerFailed + userFailed + unknownFailed
    | where settled > 0
    | project _time, feed = 'Cloud Agent turns', good = completed, total = settled
  ),
  (
    ['vercel']
    | where ['request.path'] == '/api/cron/code-review-outcome-aggregate' and ['vercel.environment'] == 'production'
    | where ['message'] has '"metric":"review_outcome"'
    | extend j = parse_json(['message'])
    | where tostring(j['metric']) == 'review_outcome'
    | project _time, obs = todatetime(j['observedAt']), ws = todatetime(j['windowStart']), completed = tolong(j['completed']), failed = tolong(j['failed']), cancelled = tolong(j['cancelled']), interrupted = tolong(j['interrupted']), durationCount = tolong(j['durationCount']), durationMs = todouble(j['durationMs'])
    | summarize arg_max(obs, _time, completed, failed, cancelled, interrupted, durationCount, durationMs) by ws
    | extend terminal = completed + failed + cancelled + interrupted
    | where terminal > 0
    | project _time, feed = 'Code Reviewer reviews', good = completed, total = terminal
  )
| summarize ['Completed %'] = 100.0 * sum(good) / sum(total) by bin_auto(_time), feed

charts.name: Cloud Agent data last updated (minutes ago)

query.apl:
['cloudflare-logpush']
| where ['ScriptName'] == 'cloud-agent-next' and ['EventType'] == 'scheduled'
| mv-expand ['Logs']
| extend j = parse_json(tostring(['Logs']['Message'][0]))
| where tostring(j['metric']) == 'agent_execution'
| summarize lastObs = max(todatetime(j['observedAt']))
| project ['minutes'] = round(todouble(datetime_diff('second', now(), todatetime(lastObs))) / 60.0, 1)
